newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo unit Fortos to sell properties.
newsitem.headline: Volvo unit Fortos to sell properties.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Tuesday its wholly-owned subsidiary AB Fortos was selling Stockholm properties worth 345 million crowns for a capital gain of 30 million crowns.
The buyer, Swedish real estate company Fabege AB, would pay for the property with two thirds of the purchasing price in cash and the remainder through a new share issue, Volvo said.
"After the sale Fortos will have 71.7 million shares in Fabege or 8.3 percent of the capital and 7.5 percent of the voles in Fabege," Volvo said.
The agreement was contingent on approval of the new share issue at an extraordinary general shareholders' meeting of Fabege, Volvo said.
